mandate: C355 — test the cross-sectional intraday SAMPLE ENTROPY (SampEn) x SEASONAL-DISLOCATION mean-reversion stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1296 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|. Sample Entropy metric over fixed intrinsic window W=64 bars ending at bar t, embedding dimension m in {2,3}, tolerance r=0.25 (z-score units): standardize z=(X-mean(X))/std(X); B_m=#{{i!=j: max_{d<m}|T_m[i][d]-T_m[j][d]|<r}}, A_m=#{{i!=j: max_{d<m+1}|T_{m+1}[i][d]-T_{m+1}[j][d]|<r}}; SampEn_m[t]=ln(B_m)-ln(A_m); sampen_m2 (m=2) and sampen_m3 (m=3). Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 2 real (sampen_m2_dev, sampen_m3_dev) + 2 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid denominators; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs/denominator requirements (t<W=64).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=64 bars ending at t: standardize z=(X-mean(X))/std(X); for m in {2,3} build length-m templates T_m[i]=z[i..i+m-1] and length-(m+1) templates T_{m+1}[i]=z[i..i+m]; B_m=# ordered pairs i!=j with max|T_m[i]-T_m[j]|<r; A_m=# ordered pairs i!=j with max|T_{m+1}[i]-T_{m+1}[j]|<r; SampEn_m=ln(B_m)-ln(A_m).
methodology.signals: sampen_m2/sampen_m3 over fixed W=64; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1296 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 4 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.sampen_invariance_note: SampEn uses Chebyshev tolerance-based template matching on the z-scored window; both B_m and A_m are window-internal, so SampEn is invariant to a constant-per-bar shift and to scaling (z-scoring). Validated against brute force in tests.
